messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Golden Compass Mining Services Team,

Please route this message to your senior recruitment or executive management team. I am sharing my profile for leadership opportunities in Saudi Arabia across ESG and sustainability, government relations, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and country-facing leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current mandate spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, executive communications and cross-functional delivery within a large-scale gold mining operation.

Golden Compass Mining Services is a strong sector fit given my mining background and experience working where operating performance depends on regulator confidence, responsible development, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution across technical and corporate teams.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and country-facing leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. My Saudi/GCC executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile, available with 30 days notice and open to employer-supported relocation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. (Zijin Mining Group)
